$schema_note: Provisional design-token draft. NOT canonical. Companion to concepts/FUNUJE-UXUI-BRAND-INTERFACE-PULL-001.md
warning: No FUNUJE source material was found in any connected system. Hex values and family names are DECLARED in the work order; all role assignments are INFERRED by the execution agent; spacing, radius and motion values are UNRESOLVED conventions proposed as starting points only. Do not treat this file as brand canon. Reconcile against 'Funuje Brand Guidelines v001' before use.

truth_labels.DECLARED: Stated in the work order by the project principal; not corroborated by a brand artifact.
truth_labels.INFERRED: Synthesized by the execution agent from multiple declared signals.
truth_labels.UNRESOLVED: No evidence exists; value is a proposed convention requiring human decision.

color._note: Hex values DECLARED. Semantic role names INFERRED. Contrast ratios VERIFIED by WCAG 2.x computation against #050505 unless stated.

role._naming_note: Namespaced to avoid the three-way collision between Signal Red, Cyan Signal and the zone 'The Signal'. See conflict 11.3.

surface.panel.label: INFERRED
surface.panel.note: 1.14:1 against ground — invisible by fill alone; requires stroke. See conflict 6.3.

surface.atmosphere.label: INFERRED
surface.atmosphere.note: 1.45:1 — surface/gradient only, never text or icon.

brand.red.label: INFERRED
brand.red.note: Fill and accent only. 4.32:1 as text on ground — large text only.

accent.cyan.label: UNRESOLVED
accent.cyan.note: No declared role. Proposed: data/telemetry in The Console and The Lab only. See conflict 11.2.

text.on-red.label: INFERRED
text.on-red.note: CORRECTION: warm-cream on signal-red measures 3.82:1 and FAILS WCAG AA for body text. White measures 4.72:1 and passes. See conflict 11.1 — requires human approval.

typography._note: Family candidates DECLARED. Role assignments INFERRED. No size scale, weight scale, or line-height is declared anywhere — UNRESOLVED.

display.use: zone titles, hero statements, drop names, wordmark lockups
display.label: DECLARED
display.open_question: Anton is single-weight with no true italic; confirm whether a multi-weight family is required. See conflict 11.5.

editorial.use: long-form storytelling in The Booth, artist essays, pull quotes, vault annotations
editorial.label: DECLARED

ui.use: all interface chrome, labels, buttons, forms, navigation, body UI
ui.label: UNRESOLVED
ui.open_question: Eight-candidate shortlist, not a decision. These are not interchangeable and licensing cost varies materially. See conflict 11.4.

mono.use: metadata, IDs, release codes, analytics, timecodes, BPM/key, catalog numbers
mono.label: DECLARED
mono.note: Load-bearing. Consistent mono metadata across all nine zones is the strongest single cue that the surfaces belong to one operating system.

scale.label: UNRESOLVED
scale.note: No type scale exists in the source or the work order.

radius._note: 'Rounded' is DECLARED; no value is given. The scale below is a proposed convention only.

spacing._note: No spacing information exists in the source or the work order. 8pt base grid proposed as convention, not finding.

elevation._note: Derived from the measured 1.14:1 panel/ground contrast: elevation cannot be carried by fill. Stroke is the primary elevation signal; glow is stateful, not ambient.

motion._note: Five motion types DECLARED. Communicative meanings INFERRED. All durations and easings UNRESOLVED — no values are declared anywhere.

pulse.use: live dots, frequency rings, countdowns, recording state
pulse.label: INFERRED
pulse.note: The only acceptable looping animation; everything else resolves.

slide.use: zone transitions, drawers, panel entry, carousel
slide.label: INFERRED

float.use: card hover lift, FAB, tooltip emergence
float.label: INFERRED

scan.use: loading, upload/analysis in The Lab, search, skeletons
scan.label: INFERRED

pacing.principle: DECLARED as 'musical, tactile, controlled'. Proposed: a tempo-derived duration scale so all motion shares one underlying beat.
pacing.easing: decisive deceleration; no bounce, elastic or overshoot (INFERRED from 'controlled')

reduced_motion._note: Nothing is declared. Required expectation stated per work order.
reduced_motion.rule: Liveness must survive reduced motion. Every motion-carried meaning requires a static equivalent (color, label, or chip).

motif._note: Motifs DECLARED. Functions INFERRED. The work order requires function, not appearance.

red-field.function: declares brand authority and ownership of a space; the loudest statement available. Scarcity preserves its power
red-field.label: INFERRED

black-glass-panel.function: the container of all system content; signifies 'this is a surface of the OS'
black-glass-panel.label: INFERRED

signal-bar.function: attention and emphasis; the macron over the E as a system mark. Fits active-state indicators, section markers, active nav underline
signal-bar.label: INFERRED

waveform.function: signifies an object with sound and duration (release, stem, session); also a progress and scrub affordance
waveform.label: INFERRED

frequency-ring.function: live, ongoing or cyclical state — broadcasting, loading, tier, progress. Circular counterpart to the waveform
frequency-ring.label: INFERRED

red-dot.function: binary live/new/unread indicator; the smallest unit of signal. Must mean exactly one thing system-wide
red-dot.label: INFERRED

cta._note: Variants DECLARED except 'quiet', which is INFERRED as necessary for dense maker-facing zones.

primary.label: DECLARED + corrected
primary.note: Declared as 'cream/white'. Cream fails AA at body size (3.82:1); white passes (4.72:1). See conflict 11.1.

secondary.label: DECLARED
secondary.note: Label must be cream/white, not red — red text on panel is 3.80:1.

premium.label: DECLARED
premium.note: membership, VIP, early access, Inner Circle entry points

quiet.label: INFERRED
quiet.note: Implied but unstated. Dense dashboards in The Console and The Lab cannot afford three loud button styles. UNRESOLVED.

zones._note: Names and one-line purposes DECLARED. Everything else in the zone model is INFERRED — see section 4 of the companion document.

the-drop-room.note: most state-dependent surface: pre-drop, live, sold-out, post-drop

the-inner-circle.note: INFERRED: structurally a permission layer that also has a surface; gates The Drop Room and modifies The Market

language._note: Preferred labels DECLARED. Avoid-list INFERRED from 'avoid generic menu language where stronger FUNUJE language exists'.

open_questions_blocking_stable_tokens: 11.1 Primary CTA contrast — cream on red fails WCAG AA (3.82:1). Requires brand approval.
11.2 Cyan Signal has no declared role. Requires brand approval.
11.3 'Signal' is overloaded four ways; engineering tokens must be namespaced.
11.4 UI typeface is an eight-candidate shortlist, not a decision. Requires brand approval.
11.5 Display face 'Anton or similar' is single-weight. Requires confirmation.
11.6 No spacing, radius, or motion values exist anywhere.
11.7 Vault / Drop Room lifecycle undefined — affects data model.
11.9 No source material was found; all of the above rests on declaration, not evidence.
